chunks: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله kissed ʿUthman ibn Maẓʿūn, may Allah be pleased with him, after his death.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عُثْمَانَ بْنَ مَظْعُونٍ: ʿUthman ibn Maẓʿūn, the individual mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله kiss ʿUthman ibn Maẓʿūn after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله kissed ʿUthman ibn Maẓʿūn after his death. It reflects a prophetic practice connected to the deceased and preserves a historical report about the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله conduct with a companion after death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.450 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The Messenger of Allah (sw) kissed ‘Uthman ibn Maz'un after his death."
